errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories are on the horizontal axis. This is a horizontal bar chart, so the categories are on the vertical axis, and the values are on the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва броя на експертите, участващи в дигитализацията
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The vertical axis displays the categories ('Над 5 г.', '5 – 10 г.', 'Под 5 г.'). The values (percentages) are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: Скалата е маркирана с числа, започващи от 0 и нарастващи до 100, с етикети на всеки десет процента.
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a visible axis scale with tick marks or labels. The values are shown as data labels next to each bar. This description of the scale is completely hallucinated.

errors.text_span: което съответства на стойност 84,4 за вертикалната ос
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the data value (84.4%) to the vertical axis. As this is a horizontal bar chart, the value corresponds to a position on the horizontal axis. This error is repeated for all three data points mentioned.
